column1: # P373 audit of void functions called through value-returning function pointers (port/tools/icall_gen.py,
# port/ultra/pc_icall.c). On the N64 the caller reads whatever the callee left in v0; the port reads 0 (icall.py
# "void result -> 0"). verdict: fixed = the caller uses the value and the asm leaves a real one in v0, so the C now
# returns it (the build checks that a fixed function is no longer void); ok = the caller ignores the value (C and
# asm), so 0 is harmless; open = the caller uses the value but the asm value cannot be written in C (see note).
# A void function called through such a site and not listed here is logged once: "[icall] UNAUDITED void target"
# (the hold-L / e2e / netrun / netpair scripts fail on it). site = ROM table[index] -> dispatching C function.
# Rows marked "static" come from P373 port_work/p373/gen_audit.py (IR icall sites x ROM tables), "census" from the
# run-time log over the e2e replay, hold-L and a 4-player Deathmatch.
